# Minute Minder
> Google Meet timer + agenda cues so teams finish on time and confirm owners & dates. Chrome extension + web dashboard.

## Core docs (source of truth)
- https://minuteminder.io/  — Product overview & quick facts
- https://minuteminder.io/features — Feature details (timer, nudges, Agenda Timer AI, analytics, teams)
- https://minuteminder.io/pricing — Plans and limits for small and large teams. 7‑day trial for free.
- https://minuteminder.io/google-meet-timer — How to add a timer to Google Meet (HowTo)

## Key facts (short answers)
- Category: Business / Meeting efficiency (SoftwareApplication)
- Platform: Google Meet via Chrome extension; web dashboard
- Differentiates from Google’s built‑in Meet timer: agenda generation, smart nudges, wrap‑up prompts, analytics, team controls, team timers and agenda.
- Privacy: least‑privilege; no A/V capture; stores agendas/outcomes/reminders only
- Regions: US, UK, EU
- Updated: 2025‑10‑10
